sections.title: Form and habitat
sections.text: The catalogue entry Ilex represents common holly (Ilex aquifolium), an evergreen tree or large shrub of European woods and hedges. It often reaches 8–10 m and may exceed 20 m.

sections.title: Leaves, flowers and fruit
sections.text: The leathery, often spiny leaves are about 7 × 3 cm. The species is usually dioecious; the spherical red drupes, 6–9 mm across, contain several seeds.

sections.title: Toxicity
sections.text: The berries are poisonous and can cause vomiting and diarrhoea. Do not eat them.
